title: Compatibility of filtered-step cohomology isomorphism
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $K$ a bounded-below cochain complex of abelian sheaves on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $T$ an étale termwise hypercohomology presentation of $K$ [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. Let $q$ be any integer. For every integer $p$, the constructed isomorphism $e_{p,q}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-filtered-step-cohomology-iso] satisfies $H^p(j_q)(T.c(p))=e_{p,q}H^p(R\Gamma(\iota))$, in diagrammatic composition order, where $j_q$ is the filtered-step inclusion and $\iota:\sigma_{\ge q}K\to K$ is the stupid-truncation inclusion. The isomorphism is the concrete restricted-resolution comparison, not a witness selected from a bare existence proposition.

lean.statement: theorem etale_filtered_step_cohomology_compatibility (X : Scheme.{u}) (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (T : EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K) (p q : ℤ) : HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.L.step q).arrow p ≫ (T.c p).hom = (etaleFilteredStepCohomologyIso X K T p q).hom ≫ (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X p).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (K.obj.ιStupidTrunc (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE q)))
